create_multiprocess_launcher: create a MultiProcessLauncher with world_size and run_process_fn to spawn Crypten MPC processes
start_multiprocess_launcher: start all spawned processes in the MultiProcessLauncher by calling the start method
join_multiprocess_launcher: join all spawned processes and assert zero exit codes using the join method
terminate_multiprocess_launcher: terminate all spawned processes in the MultiProcessLauncher using the terminate method
run_process_in_subprocess: run a function in a subprocess with Crypten init and environment variables set
